title: Capture Current Product Evidence
stopConditions: A product repository has unresolved local changes that cannot be attributed to this evidence refresh.
A repository gate fails in a way that prevents a bounded evidence packet.
A map or Node truth state would be promoted without exact repository Evidence.
verificationTarget: Project Control records the current Core, Editor, and Backend heads, verification results, promotion blockers, and next remediation targets without promoting product truth.
summary: Capture the first product resumption evidence packet after Project Control can represent executable Work paths.
